title: (RHEA-2017:3116) python-itsdangerous enhancement update
portal_summary:
Updated python-itsdangerous package that adds an enhancement is now
available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 Extras.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for Power 9|7|ppc64le
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for Power, little endian|7|ppc64le
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The python-itsdangerous package provides a Python library for passing data through untrusted environments such as HTTP cookies while ensuring data integrity.

* The python-itsdangerous packages have been changed to build also for the 64-bit ARM architecture, the little-endian variant of IBM Power Systems, and for IBM z Systems. (BZ#1504469)

Users of python-itsdangerous are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which add this enhancement.
